policies.title: Antigua and Barbuda ordinary passport: visa on arrival
policies.summary: RMI's current Parliament-hosted regulations issue a visitor visa upon arrival to citizens of countries with RMI diplomatic ties. RMI's Foreign Affairs Ministry directly announced the formalization of ties with Antigua and Barbuda in September 2025.
conditions: A visitor visa is issued upon arrival under section 6 only after the Director is satisfied about the return ticket, local address, and any other necessary information.
The visitor visa is valid for 90 days under section 6; issuance and final admission remain subject to immigration clearance and the Director's statutory discretion.
This is an ordinary-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not infer eligibility for diplomatic, official, residence, employment, crew, sponsor, or other special routes.

conflicts.explanation: RMI's Foreign Affairs Ministry directly announced formalized Antigua and Barbuda relations in September 2025. Section 6 therefore supplies the ordinary visitor visa-on-arrival route.
